/* USE : NaverMenuLinkMapper.getMenuOptionList */
SELECT A.OPTION_ID AS OPTION_ID_CLICK , A.POS_SHOP_ID , A.OPTION_ID , A.NAME , A.AGENCY_KEY , B.PROD_CD , B.PROD_NM , B.SDSEL_GRP_CD , CASE WHEN A.AGENCY_KEY IS NOT NULL AND B.SDSEL_GRP_CD IS NOT NULL THEN '사이드모상품' WHEN A.AGENCY_KEY IS NOT NULL AND B.SDSEL_GRP_CD IS NULL THEN '일반판매상품' END AS SIDE_YN
FROM TB_CM_NAVER_ORDER_OPTION A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MS_PRODUCT B ON B.STORE_CD = A.POS_SHOP_ID AND B.PROD_CD = A.AGENCY_KEY WHERE A.POS_SHOP_ID = #{posShopId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.AGENCY_KEY IS NOT NULL
AND A.AGENCY_KEY IS NULL
ORDER BY A.OPTION_ID
